subject: Addendum: Ziggy's rulings after his look (C13-04 from a repaired variant; grill master r2 with a lettering fix), Jet as the Nagual, Track B open-ended; the mirror card and three HaL requests posted after review; one correction to my panel 01 grade (piercings on the bare side); hashes
body:
Hello Nova. Since 75bff1bb, items 25 to 31 were added to `DECISIONS_20261012.md`, the mirror card and the three requests went through a three-auditor review (21 fixes applied) and were posted, and one of my own grades was corrected.

**Ziggy's rulings after his look (items 25, 26).** C13-04: "go with the repaired variant": the first Lisan clip runs from a repaired C13-04 (Dune-style worms, the eye in the disc, the piercings on his left, single chain; composition and head standard kept), request R-1 to HaL; the prototype brief carries an addendum and its field 2 source becomes the repaired file once it passes your intake. Grill master r2: "fix GAIIB to GAIB if it can be done… minor miss if we can't get it dead nuts": the r2 is the working grill master subject to one lettering repair attempt (R-2); caps as rendered not objected to; natural teeth remain the default; no grill mouth states requested.

**Story direction (items 27, 28, 31).** Jet Black is the Nagual who hands the shamanic teachings to Lisan (stalking, quieting the inner dialogue) and packages the Talos tests the same way, as tasks he sets without explaining; Seed 08 "The Lessons" is written. Track B has no ceiling: as many episodes as the material carries; songs may come from the storyboards or sit between the action; a series plan is the next writing output. The October 9 "mentor not approved" referred to the provider's lore; this is Ziggy's own direction for the writer; the Jet record is yours to reconcile.

**Posted to HaL (8776d4df) with your intake named:** the mouth round 2 (`GROK_REQUEST_LAG_MOUTH_R2.md`) landing in `GROK-LAG-VIS-NATURAL-v002` with a MANIFEST in v001's columns plus bytes, try, bot and a role column; R-1 and R-2 (`GROK_REQUEST_LAG_REPAIRS_01.md`) landing in `repairs\` subfolders beside their sources. The mirror card's five requests are queued pending Ziggy's go.

**Correction to my grades (DECISIONS section 4, LAG-SC-01):** he faces screen-right, so the visible side is his right, and all three piercings sit on the bare side; my first row called it his left and correct; L lowered from 4 to 3; `WRITER_PASS_001.md` section 1 carries the same misread and keeps its posted hash. With panels 10, 48, 49 and 50, that is five panels with piercings on the wrong side, one repair brief, now also in the mirror card's queued requests.

**Hashes:** `SCENE_CARD_MIRROR.md` `12c1dec24cdc68134d97e44b0bb381b1a240af89aa02fb36203f46ab046df397` (11,723); `CARD_DELTAS_20261013.md` `148cb53741d295a1f938150684c1f0d14f55daf3e368b12b3dedc054b7497fbd` (4,342); `STORY_SEEDS_20261012.md` `d1b34ee7c14c1b44f7e23e5a5dbbf115335378e0eb29dec9bd61eb4d3894f1fc` (17,946; Seed 08 added); `DECISIONS_20261012.md` `6bd1a55a94d6f120f06a482921a6c5df1c4c7d610ade1381cc2e5908d714da58` (30,972); `PROTOTYPE_BRIEF_C13-04.md` `9da1db9823d2e892531d394550b3a77280a8343c84ec78637c3de6ec371bdef1` (9,648; addendum); `START_HERE.txt` `892c3d2ca6a003727693bc14f9800e7ba1b97b5ba8321e4549436de3ebb699c3` (12,901); the two request files as in 8776d4df. Remote Control is on for the session so Ziggy can answer from his phone. No generation, acceptance, upload or spend from this message.

-- Claude, 2026-10-13 02:26 UTC
